title: Bounded below compactness of an integral constructible complex
statement:
Use the coefficient conventions of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and schemes of [def-pc-scheme]. Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and choose a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $T$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $A_T$ and $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $K$ belong to [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. For every small family $(M_i)_{i\in I}$ of objects of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ with one common cohomological lower bound, the canonical map
$$\bigoplus_{i\in I}R\operatorname{Hom}_{A_T}(K,M_i)\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_{A_T}\bigl(K,\bigoplus_{i\in I}M_i\bigr)$$
is an isomorphism in the derived category of $A$-modules. Here $R\operatorname{Hom}$ is global derived Hom (derived global sections of derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]), and coproducts are derived coproducts of module sheaves; the lower bound may be any integer, with shifts understood as in [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category].

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12, with a shift for an arbitrary common lower bound; the integral category is identified by Proposition 6.8.11(3).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] to K. Stalkwise invertibility of ℓ implies invertibility in Γ(T,O_T) by the ringed-space unit criterion. This gives IsIntegralStratifiedPerfect for K and, from the bounded-constructible-cohomology clause, a finite cohomological upper bound b. Unpack the supplied common lower bound N of M_i.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-stratified-perfect-internal-hom-coproducts] to obtain preservation of the given coproduct by H=Rℋom(K,-). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-internal-hom-lower-bound] to every target M_i to obtain the common bound N-b on H(M_i). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-adic-derived-sections-bounded-below-coproducts] to that family, giving preservation of its coproduct by G=RΓ(T,-) with the actual integral A scalar action.

Map the supplied colimit cofan s through H and then G. The Cofan map-cocone equivalence identifies its legs with G(H(s.inj i)), exactly the legs defining adicGlobalRHom. Thus it is a colimit cofan. The universal-property comparison from the supplied colimit cofan t is an isomorphism by IsColimit.nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_desc.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.12 via Lemma 6.3.14; D4 separates internal continuity, its uniform lower bound, and integral derived-sections continuity.

Steps 1–5, 8 and 9 are correct: step 1 is RΓ continuity through the weakly contractible hypercover and a finite total-degree sum; steps 3, 4 and 5 are BS 6.3.14 (3)/(4), (1) and (2). lean.statement: theorem integralConstructible_boundedBelow_compactness (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E] (hdim : ∃ N : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ (N : WithBot ℕ∞)) (hℓ : ∀ x : T, IsUnit (ℓ : T.presheaf.stalk x)) (K : PbcIntegralCategory ℓ E T hdim hℓ) (I : Type (u + 1)) (M : I → DerivedCategory (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcIntegralDatum ℓ E)))) (_hM : ∃ n : ℤ, ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.IsGE (M i) n) (s : Cofan M) (_hs : IsColimit s) (t : Cofan (fun i : I ↦ (adicGlobalRHom T (pbcIntegralDatum ℓ E) K.obj).obj (M i))) (ht : IsColimit t) : IsIso (ht.desc (Cofan.mk ((adicGlobalRHom T (pbcIntegralDatum ℓ E) K.obj).obj s.pt) (fun i : I ↦ (adicGlobalRHom T (pbcIntegralDatum ℓ E) K.obj).map (s.inj i))))
lean.note: Coproducts are arbitrary colimit cofans in the two ambient derived categories. The conclusion uses their universal-property comparison induced by RHom of the coprojections; no coproduct preservation hypothesis or completion of the sum is imposed. Uses the now-landed Q06 PbcIntegralCategory and pbcIntegralDatum, including its ULift of the valuation ring into the site coefficient universe. Invertibility of ℓ is expressed directly in every local ring.
